# ORCA, vendored

[ORCA](https://github.com/hundredrabbits/Orca) by Hundred Rabbits, MIT-licensed (`LICENSE.md`).
Copied unmodified from upstream commit `223e45c84db14cb77fb1d31e29a3ad94652080d8`
(2025-11-16): `desktop/sources/scripts/` → `scripts/`, `desktop/sources/links/` → `links/`,
`resources/MANUAL.txt` → `MANUAL.txt`. Do not edit these files; Field's changes live in
`/orca.html` and `/orca_field.js`, which load these scripts and wrap ORCA's IO objects at runtime.

To update: clone upstream, copy the same three paths into a new directory named for the new
commit, point `orca.html` at it, and delete this one.
